title: Queen
move_pattern: Puppet Strings → You Are Mine → Burn Bright for Me (repeats while Amalgam alive). After Amalgam dies: Off with Your Head → Execution → Enrage → Off with Your Head (loops).
notes: Queen battles alongside the TorchHeadAmalgam. While the Amalgam is alive, Queen focuses on buffing her ally with Strength while building her own Block. When the Amalgam is defeated, Queen becomes more aggressive, cycling through powerful attacks (Off with Your Head) and self-buffs (Enrage). If the Amalgam dies while Queen is about to use Burn Bright for Me, she immediately switches to Enrage instead, jumping directly into her aggressive phase.
